# international-patient-summary-ui-with-svelte

> Browser-only, read-only viewer for HL7 FHIR International Patient Summary documents (JSON or YAML), with JSON/YAML/Markdown/one-page PDF export, four locales, and a public backendless tour signing in as example@example.com.

## Docs

- [README](README.md): what it does, quick start, architecture
- [AGENTS](AGENTS.md): rules: runes, i18n, privacy, YAML, statuses
- [Specification](spec/index.md): single source of truth; §6.8 is the tour
- [Plan](plans.md): phases 1-9
- [Tasks](tasks.md): checklist with verify steps
- [Changelog](CHANGELOG.md)

## Commands

- install: `pnpm install`
- dev: `pnpm run dev`
- build: `pnpm run build`
- test: `pnpm test`
- coverage: `pnpm run test:coverage` (95% line minimum over `src/lib`)
- e2e: `pnpm run test:e2e`
- check: `pnpm run check`
- lint: `pnpm run lint`

## Routes

- [/](src/routes/+page.svelte): loader and viewer
- [/examples/](src/routes/examples/+page.svelte): the five IG examples
- [/tour/](src/routes/tour/+page.svelte): public backendless tour: sign in as example@example.com

## Modules

- [FHIR core](src/lib/fhir/): framework-free parsing, references, sections, absent states, formatting
- [Export](src/lib/export/): JSON, YAML, Markdown, one-page PDF
- [Service contract](src/lib/service/service.ts): the backend API as IpsService; its IPS check and refusal codes
- [Tour service](src/lib/service/tour-service.ts): in-memory IpsService for the tour
- [Tour session](src/lib/tour.svelte.ts): demo sign-in, seeding, open, delete, sign-out
- [Viewer state](src/lib/state.svelte.ts): the open document, in memory only

## Locales

- [en-US (source of keys)](locales/en-us/messages.yaml)
- [en-GB](locales/en-gb/messages.yaml)
- [cy-001](locales/cy-001/messages.yaml): machine-drafted; see REVIEW.md
- [zh-CN](locales/zh-cn/messages.yaml): machine-drafted; see REVIEW.md
